# function: apigateway_method_response

Builds the ARN of an `apigateway` `MethodResponse`:

```
arn:${Partition}:apigateway:${Region}::/restapis/${RestApiId}/resources/${ResourceId}/methods/${HttpMethodType}/responses/${StatusCode}
```

`${Partition}`, `${Region}` and `${Account}` come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.



## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
apigateway_method_response(rest_api_id string, resource_id string, http_method_type string, status_code string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `rest_api_id` (String) Value for `${RestApiId}` in the ARN template.
1. `resource_id` (String) Value for `${ResourceId}` in the ARN template.
1. `http_method_type` (String) Value for `${HttpMethodType}` in the ARN template.
1. `status_code` (String) Value for `${StatusCode}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given.
